data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">We recognize that providing strong liquidity with tight spreads on BTC can generate significant trading volume, and this will, to some extent, already be reflected in the volume-based rewards.</p><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">However, providing $10M in liquidity on BTC at 2–3 bps might not produce the same volume, and the benefit of 2–3 bps of better execution must be weighted against the risk of posting that liquidity.</p><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">With this in mind, we aim to incentivize market makers to provide high-quality liquidity even when it does not result in large trading volumes, ensuring that traders can execute sizable positions when needed.</p><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">Another aspect concerns altcoins that currently lack traction on Lighter or have higher volumes on other exchanges. Traders may avoid these markets due to limited liquidity, while MMs may skip them because of low volume. To address this, we will assign a higher weight to such markets.</p><h3 id="market-weights" class="text-lg @xs:text-xl @lg:text-2xl font-semibold heading font-heading pdf-heading block pr-6 print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">For a selection of exchanges, we will approximate two multipliers that track how the volume and open interest on those exchanges compare to Lighter. We will then adjust the external volumes and open interest based on these multipliers. Using the adjusted values together with Lighter’s own data, we will determine the final market weight.</p><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">Note: this approach shifts weight toward tokens that are heavily traded (e.g., BTC, ETH, SOL) and also assigns higher weight to tokens that are popular on other exchanges but not yet on Lighter, while maintaining balanced weights for tokens that show stronger activity on Lighter itself.</p><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph users will receive points proportional to the share of liquidity they provide. At each sample, we will evaluate several metrics, such as:</p><ul class="min-w-0 space-y-2 decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full"><li class="leading-normal flex items-start"><div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint"><div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"></div></div><div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2"><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid min-h-lh [h2]:pt-0 [h3]:pt-0 [h4]:pt-0 mx-0 text-start self-start justify-start">who is providing liquidity within the top $10k, $30k, $100k, $300k, …</p></div></li><li class="leading-normal flex items-start"><div class="text-base leading-normal mr-1 flex min-h-lh min-w-6 items-center justify-center text-tint"><div class="before:content-(--pseudoBefore--content) before:font-var" style="--pseudoBefore--content:'•';--font-family:Arial;font-size:min(1.5em, 24px);line-height:1"></div></div><div class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col space-y-2"><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid min-h-lh [h2]:pt-0 [h3]:pt-0 [h4]:pt-0 mx-0 text-start self-start justify-start">who is providing liquidity within 1 bps, 2 bps, 5 bps, 10 bps of mid-price</p></div></li></ul><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">These thresholds will depend on the market — for example, $10k in liquidity on BTC is relatively small, while $50M on YZY would be unrealistically high. For each market, we will use approximately 6–10 of these metrics, each carrying the same weight.</p><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">Note: these metrics will be computed separately for the bid and ask sides.</p><h4 id="volatility" class="text-base @xs:text-lg @lg:text-xl score, which acts as a multiplier when providing liquidity. This is meant to incentivise market makers to provide liquidity even during volatile periods.</p><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">Without the volatility multiplier, each order book sample would carry the same weight. Because the multiplier makes some snapshots contribute more than others, we will calculate the total score on a daily basis. To prevent a single trading day from dominating the results (for example, accounting for 90% of all points), we will implement a ceiling mechanism that ensures each day receives at least 8.33% of the total points for liquidity provision.</p><p data-cover-aware-text="" class="paragraph decoration-primary/6 max-w-3xl w-full print:break-inside-avoid text-start self-start justify-start">For example, if one day in the week experiences very high volatility for 20 hours, the points for that day would be capped at 50% of the total pool. This scenario is unlikely, as we assume such volatility would last for only part of a single day, with the remaining six days being normal.</p><h4 id="example" class="text-base @xs:text-lg @lg:text-xl
